extracted.intended_audience: researchers and organizations seeking grant funding from Schmidt Sciences
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and apply to open funding calls hosted by Schmidt Sciences; follow the organization's application pathway and center-specific calls. The page lists current Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Expressions of Interest (EOIs) and makes clear unsolicited proposals are not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: No unsolicited proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: "We proactively seek out grant opportunities and do not accept unsolicited proposals."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must not send unsolicited proposals; only respond to advertised open calls. The site directs users to the current open calls listed on the page as the proper application pathway.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply only via listed open calls/RFPs/EOIs
rubrics_metrics.description: "Please find our current open calls listed below." (examples shown: VIEW-2 Call for EOIs; 2026 AI Interpretability RFP; Research Frontiers Network (IIT Delhi): Net-Zero India; 2026 Science of Trustworthy AI RFP)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To be considered for funding, applicants should click 'Apply' on one of the specific listed opportunities and follow that opportunity's instructions; do not attempt to submit proposals outside those calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center alignment / use filters to find relevant calls
rubrics_metrics.description: Page lists Centers (AI & Advanced Computing; Astrophysics & Space; Biosciences; Climate; Science Systems) and provides filters ("Reset Filters").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should select the center(s) appropriate to their work to find relevant open calls. Use the provided filters to narrow opportunities to the correct thematic area before applying.
